# COBOL Intrinsic Functions Specification (#4712)

Chapter: *Intrinsic functions*, *ACCEPT statement*.

| Rule ID | Status | Title | IBM Manual Reference | Register |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `RT-FUNC-ACCEPT-DATE` | `MATCHED` | ACCEPT FROM DATE / DATE YYYYMMDD / DAY / DAY YYYYDDD / TIME: the run's clock as the unsigned integer item IBM describes, moved as that item | cobol-lr: ACCEPT statement: DATE/DAY/TIME | - |
| `RT-FUNC-ACCEPT-SYSIN` | `MATCHED` | ACCEPT identifier FROM SYSIN: the next line of standard input moved to the target as an alphanumeric MOVE; no record left stops the run by name | cobol-lr: ACCEPT statement: SYSIN | - |
| `RT-FUNC-CASE` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION UPPER-CASE / LOWER-CASE of single-byte letters | cobol-lr: UPPER-CASE and LOWER-CASE functions | - |
| `RT-FUNC-CURRENT-DATE` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE where the project has no clock bean: YYYYMMDDHHMMSShh and the UTC offset of the run's clock | cobol-lr: CURRENT-DATE function | - |
| `RT-FUNC-DATE-INTEGER` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE / DATE-OF-INTEGER: day 1 is 1 January 1601 (INTDATE(ANSI)) or 15 October 1582 (INTDATE(LILIAN)) | cobol-lr: Date intrinsic functions | - |
| `RT-FUNC-INTEGER-ABS-MIN-MAX` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION INTEGER (floor), INTEGER-PART (toward zero), ABS, MIN, MAX | cobol-lr: Mathematical intrinsic functions | - |
| `RT-FUNC-MOD-REM` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION MOD (a - b * FLOOR(a / b)) and REM (a - b * INTEGER-PART(a / b)); a zero b gives 0 with no size error, as the oracle | cobol-lr: MOD and REM functions | - |
| `RT-FUNC-NUMVAL` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION NUMVAL / NUMVAL-C: the number in a text (spaces, one sign + - CR DB, a decimal point; NUMVAL-C a currency sign and commas) | cobol-lr: NUMVAL and NUMVAL-C functions | - |
| `RT-FUNC-RANDOM` | `DIFFERS` | FUNCTION RANDOM: one run unit's sequence (glibc random_r TYPE_3, as the oracle); the numbers differ from z/OS's, the interface as IBM documents it | cobol-lr: RANDOM function | `C12` |
| `RT-FUNC-REVERSE` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION REVERSE | cobol-lr: REVERSE function | - |
| `RT-FUNC-TEST-NUMVAL` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL / TEST-NUMVAL-C: 0 when valid, else the position of the first character that makes it invalid (the length + 1 when it ends early), as the oracle | cobol-lr: TEST-NUMVAL and TEST-NUMVAL-C functions | - |
| `RT-FUNC-TRIM` | `MATCHED` | FUNCTION TRIM [LEADING / TRAILING]: spaces only removed (low-values stay); an all-space argument gives a zero-length result, as the oracle | cobol-lr: TRIM function | - |
